messages.text: BL-1791 🎵 in progress — test_openrouter_provider_support.sh is red on main since 4ed88430b2 (2026-09-01, 27 days unnoticed): its fixture stages the cleaner on --model qwen/qwen3-32b and case 03 lists the cleaner for OpenRouter, but the launch-script writer checks the qwen-cloud host sniff before role_uses_openrouter (BL-1328's ruled precedence), so the cleaner's script takes the Token Plan branch and 'cleaner should be OpenRouter' fails; the fixture stops pairing a qwen slug with an OpenRouter role, the precedence is untouched
